title: Research construction: share dyadic queries across distinct outputs (40 to 13 children)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A batch with five separate centered dyadic BIT outputs normally restores each output's address layout independently. Allowing the common source to be temporarily permuted lets those outputs share one query tour: **40 to 13 complete ordinary ADDRESS children**, **240 to 78 affine events**, and the same **30 XOR scans**, with no extra full row. The comparison already uses PR953's optimized separate-target batches.

This is a **scoped recursive-interface construction; no new kappa**. Every output, source and dirty spectator has the correct endpoint. The changed permission is essential: the source must be exclusively writable and unobserved until batch exit. Thirteen queries are proved minimal only in the declared source-query/output-XOR alphabet. Each query has its full seven-event lowering and complete coefficient-specific invoice; the new query histogram is componentwise dominated by the baseline.

The [proof and typed recurrence](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/README.md) retain role-dependent child/affine prices and all preparation, source access, routing, dispatch, temporary storage and restoration costs. No physical supplier caller, DATA-to-ADDRESS recursive compiler, all-size/tape/hosting admission, runtime saving or analytic transfer is established. The selected record is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. Contribution: `04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2`. OS assignment seed **55**, recursive interfaces; **refined** `persistent-boundary` scope. [Task card](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/TASK.json) · [source pins](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/SOURCES.json) · [claim #1493](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1493).

The new object has distinct output ports and a temporarily mutable shared source. PR953 at `5f052969846b0882ac4e22d9e818dd8ac05ea56f` batches several terms on one target with an unchanged source; PR840 at `da2cd0dd2229e08b61b174a8835a2c2bb99d2230` provides the signed dyadic lowering and pair construction. Their results are credited and reused. PR1235 is related source-tour reasoning in a different phase/rank model.

The [final overlap snapshot](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/OVERLAP.json) covers **759 open PRs and 193 discussion/comment records**, complete pagination and no warnings. Nearby Discussions1501 and1505 explicitly distinguish their additive-connector and port-borrowing scopes. This is bounded overlap evidence, not a novelty certificate. Only this new research directory is added.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-dyadic-source
```

Expected: `PASS_SHARED_DYADIC_SOURCE children=40->13 affine=240->78 XOR=30 patterns=768 no_new_kappa`, seven passing package tests, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

- All **768** declared small incidence patterns; separate Laurent and cyclic dirty-state/inverse checks; **25,088** cyclic dirty columns per implementation.
- All thirteen native powers: **104** rational columns, **624** modular columns and **850,408** complete six-field ADDRESS/spectator inputs. Both complete array words pass **20,412** dirty columns per implementation.
- **24** mathematical/admission controls, including every native event omission and a collapsed-output word whose aggregate is correct while the separate outputs are wrong.
- Python **3.12.2** registered replay, seven package tests and all **20** onboarding tests pass on macOS arm64. Optimized isolated Python **3.14.6** source export without Git reproduces the exact receipt byte-for-byte, keeps read-only files unchanged, and rejects an actual corrupted evidence file. Source/certificate corruption and missing-child controls pass.
- `make selected-record-check`, source-pin metadata and staged whitespace checks pass. Refreshed main and all ten inputs remain identical. [Validation record](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/VALIDATION.json).

Finite tests support the separate written proof; they are not formal verification of the multiplication theorem. Selected cold replay, physical tape/compiler execution, hosted CI acceptance and independent human review were not performed.

Original notices and licenses are source-pinned inputs. No priority is claimed for the native lowering, single-target tour or generic source-gauge idea.

## Open next questions

[The package](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/README.md#open-next-questions) gives two bounded follow-ups: find an actual caller with no intermediate source observation and price its complete supplier invoice; or study a small formal Laurent instance permitting queries on both source and outputs. A concrete caller/compiler is the blocker to adoption, and the current complex supplier remains binding.
